module security.password_strength
  purpose: Classify passwords as Weak, Fair or Strong.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: How hard a password is to guess.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Strong needs 12 or more characters with letters, digits and another kind of character; Fair needs 8 or more characters; everything else is Weak.
  tags: security, password
  example: classify("Abcdef123!xy") is Strong
  example: classify("abcdefgh1234") is Fair
  example: classify("password") is Fair
  example: classify("short") is Weak
  example: classify("") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  let letters_found be password.matches(raw "^.*[A-Za-z].*$")
  let digits_found be password.matches(raw "^.*[0-9].*$")
  let others_found be password.matches(raw "^.*[^A-Za-z0-9].*$")
  if size is at least 12 and letters_found and digits_found and others_found then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

```
module accounts.password
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: The strength class of a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Strong needs 12 or more characters with letters, digits and another kind of character; Fair needs 8 or more characters; anything else is Weak.
  tags: security, validation
  example: classify("Tr0ub4dor&3x") is Strong
  example: classify("Abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("abc123") is Weak
  example: classify("") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z]$")
  let has_digit be for each character in password.characters() any character.matches(raw "^[0-9]$")
  let has_other be for each character in password.characters() any not character.matches(raw "^[A-Za-z0-9]$")
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

```
module security.passwords
  purpose: Classify how strong a password is.

public type Strength is one of
  purpose: The strength rating of a password.
  Weak
  Fair
  Strong
end

public function classify(password: Text)
  returns Strength
  purpose: Rate a password as Strong (12 or more characters with letters, digits and another kind of character), Fair (8 or more characters) or Weak.
  tags: security, passwords
  example: classify("Tr0ub4dor&3xyz") is Strong
  example: classify("abcdefghijkl1") is Fair
  example: classify("abcdefgh") is Fair
  example: classify("short") is Weak
  example: classify("") is Weak

  let size be password.length()
  let has_letter be password.matches(raw ".*[A-Za-z].*")
  let has_digit be password.matches(raw ".*[0-9].*")
  let has_other be password.matches(raw ".*[^A-Za-z0-9].*")
  if size is at least 12 and has_letter and has_digit and has_other then
    return Strong
  otherwise if size is at least 8 then
    return Fair
  otherwise
    return Weak
  end
end

test "a long mixed password is strong"
  check classify("Correct-Horse-9-Battery") is Strong
end

test "a long password without symbols is only fair"
  check classify("abcdefghijklmnop") is Fair
end

test "a short password is weak"
  check classify("a1!") is Weak
end
